def apply(state, mv):
    cyc, d = MOVES[mv]; n=len(cyc)
    s = dict(state)
    vals = [state[cyc[i]] for i in range(n)]

        s[cyc[i]] = vals[src]
    return s

def cyc_src(order):
    n=len(order)
    return {order[i]: order[(i+1)%n] for i in range(n)}
